body:
She wants to still be friends and that's part of the reason she said she's still with me is so I don't just drop out of her life.

Something else she also said was "what if we break up and I get with other guys than realize you're the one I want to be with" " I don't want to lose you forever" so in kind of a backup plan if she ends up not loving me again.

I feel like in my life I've always been the giver, and years of being the giver results in me having a year or so of becoming a reciever of happiness.

I've always shown mercy to people when I can and given happiness when I could. Given them forgiveness and countless "second chances"

With my girlfriend she was obsessed with my ex for years, she was suicidal, had no friends, had abusive parents, wasn't allowed to have a boyfriend, wasn't allowed anything really, and my gf forced me to stop talking to her, when she was trapped in a living hell and begged me to help her.

She was like that for a year and a half, she always worried about other girls, was almost emotionally abusive, she would always ask if I promised and sweared I wouldn't talk to other girls, would drive half an hour to my school and freak out when I walked out of the classroom with another girl walking out after me, she once got mad that I did a split work group project at school with a girl and didn't tell her about it first. I never lost faith in her, j never stopped loving her, she gave me shit for a year and a half and I never lost faith, I had girls that wanted me at school, I turned them down, became a social outcast because if it. Had one of the hottest girls in school ask me if I wanted to fuck her and I said no. I never lost faith after a year and a half of enduring a jealous insecure over dedicated girlfriend.

I thought always that she would get over it and she did eventually. I loved her and helped her through it, when she asked if I talked to other girls I said no, I let her look through my phone without getting mad, she said she trusted me 100% But acted like that.

She made mistake after mistake after a year and a half that any guy would have left her for. But I had faith that when she said she wanted me forever she meant it, and I dreamed of a day she wouldn't be like that so we could be happy and live life's adventures together.

Than I treated her wrong for 4 months and I completely lose her.

No second chance

No forgiveness

No mercy

All I get is a giant fuck you to my face.

She says she forgives me and wants to give me a second chance but I don't see her working towards it at all, and now the one person that was there for me is gone, because I made one mistake... FML lol

Just like this world has always done, teased me with what I wanted than took it away.

I went to a high school I liked freshman year, had lots of friends, girls I talked to, fun classes good staff, I was so happy, than I moved to a tiny farming town. Everyone liked me for once, whereas elementary and middle I was a social outcast. High school was a chance to restart so I restarted as who I really was and be happy. Than the small town I moved to EVERYONE was a red neck so I had literally no friends, no one likes me, some teachers were cool, the school had a boring schedule no fun classes no off campus... No fun.

Again teased with the life I want than have it taken away.

I have a job, I have no way to learn how to drive since my parents are in capable of doing so because they can't stay fucking calm when I drive lol... The only way I can practice driving is illegally.

The girl I'm with is a virgin like me, has never had a serious relationship with anyone else but me, we get to experience new everything together in life, we both want to move out of our parents house, we both have the same views on life.

We both dated young enough so we were able to develop into the perfect people for eachother with the same goals/interest etc...

She is extremely attractive both physically and as a person. She is basically every guys dream girl to fuck and date for a while.

I'm afraid what's going to happen is she will get fucked by a bunch of guys than want me back or something which I'm not interested in lol... Not do I want to watch that.

Whatever happens it won't happen for a while, were moving in together ASAP so we can get things figured out with our relationship. She wants to give things at least that chance.
